notes: Read by an external reader (Meta Muse) from a written spec (/mnt/project-files/muse-permit-appeals/prompt.md) over the volume's Internet Archive OCR text, minutesofmeeting19931994s; converted here, page-located in the hOCR, quotations and street numbers checked against the OCR, and resolved here. Personal names were removed from every field on conversion.

coverage.note: 1993-01-06 to 1993-12-15. Only the 1993 meetings of the combined 1993-1994 volume (identifier minutesofmeeting19931994s) were extracted; 1994 meetings were not read. No minutes for the dates listed in skipped appear in the volume; whether no meeting was held or the scan omits them is not stated in the minutes. Scan quirks: the July 21, December 1 and December 15, 1993 meetings each appear twice in the scan (identical text) and are counted once; the February 3, February 24, June 16 and July 7 meeting headings misprint the year as 1995 and are recorded as 1993; the August 17, 1993 meeting was held on a Tuesday. Conflicts recorded as printed: the penalty arithmetic in Appeal Nos. 93-131 and 93-158 (totals do not equal two times the stated regular fees); the subject-line conflict in 93-064 (1109 Oak Street); the architect conflict for 870 North Point Street (93-005/93-006/93-009, different architects named February 24/April 7 and May 12). Skips of note: street-artist certificate appeals (93-073, 93-094), peddler and pushcart appeals (92-249, 93-033, 93-202), taxicab medallion appeals (93-111), the motorized rickshaw appeal (90-021), a driver-vehicle permit appeal (93-044), and the masseuse and outcall massage permit revocations (93-215, 93-216) for which the minutes print no address. Open threads into 1994: 93-172 (816 Dolores Street), 93-167 (715 Bush Street), 93-196 (2559-29th Avenue) and 93-208 (210 Post Street) continued to January 12, 1994; 93-198 (68 Mars Street) rescheduled to January 5, 1994; 93-160 (31 Ervine Street) and 93-092 (55 Dorantes Avenue) continued to the call of the chair; the 10 Sussex Street jurisdiction request continued indefinitely January 13, 1993; jurisdiction grants whose appeals may follow: Poppy Lane lots (granted August 4, 1993), 814-24th Avenue (granted November 17, 1993) and 1430 Noriega Street (granted December 15, 1993); Appeal Nos. 88-293, 88-294 and 88-295 (959 Powell Street and 8 Wetmore Street) remain open, the environmental impact report not yet prepared as of November 10, 1993.
